drivingQuestion: Are salting and tanning one labor, and is salting meat tanning?
outcomeNote: Drafting replaces one of the pair; salting meat for home use is not tanning even per Rabba bar Rav Huna

segments.he: וְהַמּוֹלְחוֹ וְהַמְעַבְּדוֹ. הַיְינוּ מוֹלֵחַ וְהַיְינוּ מְעַבֵּד! רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן וְרֵישׁ לָקִישׁ דְּאָמְרִי תַּרְוַיְיהוּ: אַפֵּיק חַד מִינַּיְיהוּ וְעַיֵּיל שִׂירְטוּט. אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא: הַאי מַאן דְּמָלַח בִּישְׂרָא — חַיָּיב מִשּׁוּם מְעַבֵּד. רָבָא אָמַר: אֵין עִיבּוּד בָּאוֹכָלִין. אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי: וַאֲפִילּוּ רַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא לָא אָמַר אֶלָּא דְּקָא בָּעֵי לֵיהּ לְאוֹרְחָא, אֲבָל לְבֵיתָא — לָא מְשַׁוֵּי אִינִישׁ מֵיכְלֵיהּ עֵץ.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna, among those liable for performing primary categories of labor: «And one who salts it and one who tans it.» The Gemara asks: The prohibited labor of «salting is the same as» the prohibited labor of «tanning,» i.e., salting is a stage in the tanning process. «Rabbi Yoḥanan and Reish Lakish both said: Remove one of them and replace» it with «drafting.» In their opinion, the labor of drafting, drawing lines on the hide to indicate where it should be cut, should replace salting in the list of thirty-nine labors. «Rabba bar Rav Huna said: One who salts meat» on Shabbat to preserve it «is liable due to» the labor of «tanning. Rava said: There is no tanning» with regard to «food.» No action taken with food falls into this category. «Rav Ashi said: And even Rabba bar Rav Huna said» it falls into the category of tanning «only when he needs to» pack the meat for «a trip» and salts it thoroughly. «However, to» eat in «the house, a person does not render his food» inedible, tantamount to a piece of «wood.» In that case, he certainly would not salt the meat to a degree that would approximate tanning.
